principles: separate remote approval per release surface
no iOS public release until every P0 is verified closed

owner_decisions.question: Should scale be included in App Store v1, restricted beta, or disabled/post-launch?
Should ESP32 scale remain post-launch/restricted beta only?
Which Admin operational workflows, if any, may insert immediately APPROVED Events?
May staff edit submitted Events; if yes, which fields, statuses, time window, role, and audit rule?
Should dynamic iOS backend configuration exist at all?
What legal entity and exact privacy, terms, and support URLs/contact should App Store use?
Which repository becomes the canonical BARINV.ca source?
Should the iOS release merge to protected main or use a protected release branch?

phases.name: Backup and freeze
phases.exit_gate: Verified Git/database/site/app/scale backups, checksums, restore guides, baselines, sufficient storage, and owner decisions

phases.name: Supabase and Event authorization closure
phases.exit_gate: Isolated authorization suites pass; migration dry runs contain only approved forward migrations

phases.name: Barback outbox and Scale Bridge safety
phases.exit_gate: No silent outbox loss and no usable untrusted scale payload

phases.name: iOS backend configuration hardening
phases.exit_gate: Arbitrary backend redirects fail in source, built, and installed app

phases.name: App legal privacy and support pages
phases.exit_gate: Owner-approved public app privacy, terms, and support URLs return HTTPS 200

phases.name: Scale certification or feature gating
phases.exit_gate: Supported physical matrix passes or scale is disabled/gated from public v1

phases.name: iOS release governance
phases.exit_gate: Approved branch strategy, unique version/build, reproducible archive evidence, and annotated RC checkpoint

phases.name: Final retest and release-readiness checkpoint
phases.exit_gate: Fresh audit reports P0=0 and every backup/test/physical/release gate passes

items.root_cause: Internal backup and prune SECURITY DEFINER functions have broad execute grants and no caller authorization.
items.safest_fix: Revoke PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated execute from every overload; grant only the exact maintenance/service role without changing data or function behavior.
tests: maintenance service path works in isolated harness
ACL, owner, search_path, and row-count assertions
items.rollback: Do not restore anonymous grants; issue a forward grant correction to the exact scheduler/service role.
items.risk_if_delayed: Anonymous privileged maintenance and pruning remain possible.
items.suggested_commit: fix(db): restrict privileged backup maintenance functions

items.root_cause: Broad staff update policy allows inventory-relevant Event field changes; current firewall guards status only.
items.safest_fix: Define owner-approved mutability, add a protected-field BEFORE UPDATE guard, narrow RLS, and preserve existing status RPC/job/audit behavior.
tests: staff protected-field changes rejected for every status
mixed status and field change rejected
manager status-only review remains exact-once audited
review, CSV, and 1500-row durable suites remain green
existing Event values and hashes unchanged by migration
items.rollback: Prefer a forward correction; never automatically restore broad staff update authorization.
items.risk_if_delayed: Approved inventory history can be rewritten without review or audit.

items.root_cause: Legacy insert policies scope callers but do not force client-created Events to begin PENDING.
items.safest_fix: Inventory insert sources; add an ordered BEFORE INSERT contract guard; keep Barback/CSV PENDING; move approved operational inserts, if retained, behind one audited manager/server RPC.
likely_files: index.html if operational insert callers require RPC migration
iOS www/index.html if equivalent callers exist
tests: Barback PENDING and server auto-approval remain correct
approved operational RPC authorized and audited if retained
backup: inventory of all Event insert callers
items.rollback: Use a forward correction or temporarily disable a broken workflow; never reopen generic final-status inserts.
items.risk_if_delayed: Clients can bypass PENDING review and exact-once audit.

items.root_cause: Outbox persistence failure truncates the queue and does not report failure.
items.safest_fix: Remove truncation, make persistence/round-trip success explicit, preserve prior queue, retain failed new record visibly, block success/navigation, and preserve client_event_id idempotency.
likely_files: iOS bundled barback.html only in a separate reviewed sync
items.rollback: Do not return to silent truncation; forward hotfix or explicitly disable offline queueing.
items.risk_if_delayed: Live Event submissions can silently disappear.
items.suggested_commit: fix(barback): prevent silent outbox data loss

items.root_cause: Public Realtime broadcast payloads directly control usable grams/stable state.
items.safest_fix: Stop public realtime ingestion immediately; disable Bridge or use authenticated HTTPS/private transport with claim-derived scope, server-side validation, freshness, sequence, range, and stability controls.
tests: forged stable, stale, replayed, malformed, non-finite, negative, and extreme values rejected
valid station and receiver limited to one scope
stale reading never enables Use Weight
items.rollback: Kill switch disables Bridge; never restore public untrusted broadcast ingestion.
items.suggested_commit: fix(scale): reject untrusted realtime bridge weights
items.suggested_migration: 20260729110000_secure_scale_bridge_transport.sql only if catalog changes are required

items.root_cause: Unsigned deep link carries arbitrary backend URL/key and persists it after a confirmation prompt.
items.safest_fix: Remove from public v1 and pin approved backend, or replace with a signed short-lived token exchange and strict allowlist.
likely_files: iOS ios/App/App/public/index.html generated by Capacitor copy
optional portal-token-exchange Function if signed exchange is retained
tests: raw and encoded cfg routes rejected
wrong host/project, expiry, bad signature, replay, malformed and oversized payload fail
items.rollback: Ship a forward higher build; pinned Production configuration remains the safe fallback.
items.risk_if_delayed: Crafted links can redirect credentials and operational data.

items.root_cause: Live policies cover the marketing website, not the operational app, and no stable app support URL is ready.
items.safest_fix: Establish canonical website source and publish owner/legal-approved app privacy, terms, and support pages matching actual permissions/data flows.
tests: content matches Info.plist and application data flow
items.rollback: Preserve compliant emergency legal pages even if the broader website deployment rolls back.
items.risk_if_delayed: App Review rejection and inaccurate privacy disclosure.
items.suggested_commit: docs(legal): add BARINV app privacy terms and support

items.root_cause: Arboleaf conversion/calibration is based on insufficient captures and conflicts with unresolved Scale Lab documentation.
items.safest_fix: Run traceable physical certification across supported devices/ranges or gate scale out of public v1; default to disabled until evidence passes.
likely_files: iOS www/index.html if gating/decoder changes are needed
barback.html if gating/decoder changes are needed
supabase_objects: P0-04 transport objects only if Bridge remains supported
tests: three physical devices if generally supported
items.rollback: Feature flag defaults disabled; use manual entry instead of an unverified decoder.
items.risk_if_delayed: Wrong weights and bottle percentages can silently corrupt inventory.

items.root_cause: Release candidate is untagged on a feature branch, origin/main is stale, and version/build are 1.0/1.
items.safest_fix: After all other P0s close, use an approved protected branch strategy, unique version/build, reproducible archive evidence, RC tag, TestFlight gate, then stable tag.
likely_files: verified www and generated public assets
tests: JS syntax, Capacitor copy, diff check, Xcode build, app launch
items.rollback: Never move tags or rewrite history; ship a new higher build and retain the last verified stable build.
items.risk_if_delayed: Submitted binary cannot be traced, reproduced, or rolled back safely.
items.suggested_commit: chore(ios): prepare App Store release version

safe_combination: P0-01 and P0-02 share one Event write-contract design branch, migration, and isolated harness cycle.
P0-04 and P0-08 share one owner scale-scope decision and kill-switch model but deploy separately.
P0-07 legal URLs are inputs to P0-09 App Store metadata.
must_be_separate: P0-03 maintenance ACL migration from Event authorization migration
P0-05 outbox release from Scale Bridge release
P0-04 Function/transport deployment from web UI deployment
P0-06 iOS security build from web and database releases
P0-07 website/legal deployment from product code
P0-08 physical certification from code-only validation
P0-09 release checkpoint after all other P0 closures
definition_of_done: fresh audit P0 count is zero
anonymous privileged maintenance execute is absent
normal staff cannot mutate protected submitted/final Event fields
Barback PENDING and server auto-approval remain correct
outbox persistence never silently loses or falsely reports an Event
Scale Bridge accepts no untrusted stale or cross-scope weight
Arboleaf is physically certified or disabled/gated
iOS cannot be redirected to an arbitrary backend
app privacy terms and support URLs are live and approved
all backup restore local physical and Production-safe gates pass
no unresolved P0 owner decision remains
next_approval: Owner review and answers to D1-D8, followed by separate approval for Phase 0 backup/freeze only. This plan authorizes no implementation or remote mutation.
